project.title: Example Project
project.standfirst: One sentence on where the project stands today: what has merged, what is being built, what is waiting on a decision.

head.outcome: The outcome every job feeds: the one thing the project exists to make true
head.test: how that outcome is judged (e.g. the owner's walkthrough verdict), never a green gate alone

owed: Something the project still owes, kept visible until it is done or dropped on the owner's word.

lesson.title: A lesson that holds across jobs
lesson.rule: The rule it leaves, in one or two sentences.

alerts: Anything the owner must not miss, e.g. the tracker disagreeing with the repository.
facts: A standing fact about the project, e.g. a path no job may touch.

jobs.title: Frozen acceptance controls
jobs.summary: What this job made possible, in one or two sentences.
notes: A lesson or debt worth keeping visible on the board.

figures.label: tests red at head that were green at base

jobs.lesson: The one lesson this job leaves, the same one its Logbook card carries.

jobs.title: First buildable slice
jobs.summary: What it builds and why it is next.

jobs.title: A decision, not a build
jobs.summary: No work order can unblock this; it needs the owner's call or a research spike.
jobs.decision: What exactly must be decided, by whom, and what each answer would unlock.
